content: Automation script executed scene import, render reference, and coverage optimizer steps. Import phase completed with timing measured; dialog interactions handled extreme/import confirmation and close actions. Reference workflow included clicking 'Render 360 Reference', waiting for graybox/re-render prompt, dismissing overlays, switching to Reference workspace tab, and optionally using attached reference with start-checking action. Coverage optimizer was triggered via Reference Settings dialog; result or failure status was awaited with 1,800,000ms timeout. If failed, error thrown with message from failed locator. Post-optimization, heap metrics (usedJSHeapSize, totalJSHeapSize, jsHeapSizeLimit) were captured from performance.memory if available. Report object includes ok flag, model path/bytes, importMilliseconds, optimizationMilliseconds, totalMilliseconds, importReport, and analysisText.
